name: Button
description: Primary action button component with variants for different emphasis levels and interactive states. Supports onClick handlers, disabled states, and multiple size options.

name: Input
description: Text input field component for collecting user text data. Supports validation, placeholder text, error states, and accessibility features.

name: Select
description: Dropdown selection component allowing users to choose one or multiple options from a list. Includes search functionality and keyboard navigation.

name: Checkbox
description: Binary toggle control for boolean input. Supports checked, unchecked, and indeterminate states with accessibility labels.

name: Radio
description: Radio button component for mutually exclusive selections within a group. Part of radio button groups for single-choice scenarios.

name: Card
description: Container component for grouping related content with optional header, body, and footer sections. Supports elevation, borders, and interactive states.

name: Modal
description: Dialog overlay component that appears on top of page content. Includes backdrop, close handlers, and focus trap for accessibility.

name: Tabs
description: Tabbed navigation component for switching between different views or content sections. Supports controlled and uncontrolled modes.

name: Badge
description: Small status indicator or label component for highlighting information. Supports colors, sizes, and positioning on other elements.

name: Alert
description: Notification banner component for displaying important messages. Includes severity variants (info, success, warning, error) and dismissible option.

name: Tooltip
description: Contextual information overlay that appears on hover or focus. Provides additional details without cluttering the interface.

name: Table
description: Structured data grid component with sortable columns, pagination, and row selection. Supports custom cell renderers and responsive layouts.

name: Spinner
description: Loading indicator component showing indeterminate progress. Useful for async operations and data fetching states.

name: Breadcrumb
description: Navigation aid showing the current page's location within the site hierarchy. Supports custom separators and link rendering.

name: Avatar
description: User profile image component with fallback to initials. Supports various sizes, shapes, and status indicators.

name: Slider
description: Range input component for selecting numerical values by dragging. Supports single and range selection with step intervals.

name: Switch
description: Toggle switch component for binary on/off settings. Visually distinct from checkbox for immediate state changes.

name: Accordion
description: Collapsible content panels component for organizing information in expandable sections. Supports single or multiple panels open.

name: Progress
description: Linear progress indicator showing determinate task completion percentage. Useful for upload, download, and multi-step processes.

name: Menu
description: Contextual menu component with nested items, dividers, and action handlers. Triggered by buttons or right-click interactions.
